steps.title: Read the dispute
steps.prompt: Read all 5 of these fields of this dispute request (every one is needed): "Dispute · Reason", "Dispute · Amount", "Dispute · Payment type", "Dispute · Filed on" and "Dispute · Channel": what the customer says, the amount, the kind of payment, when and how they filed it.

steps.title: Read the disputed payment
steps.prompt: Read all 4 of these fields of this dispute request (every one is needed): "Payment · Paid to", "Payment · Date", "Payment · Authentication" and "Payment · Device": who was paid, when, how the payment was authenticated (3-D Secure, chip, PIN, app confirmation), and from which device or terminal.

steps.title: Check the eligibility
steps.prompt: Read all 5 of these fields of this dispute request (every one is needed): "Eligibility · Suggested route", "Eligibility · Time to claim", "Eligibility · Merchant contacted", "Eligibility · Earlier disputes" and "Eligibility · Refund by the next business day (PSD2)": the time left to claim (card 120 days, SEPA rules), whether the merchant was contacted, earlier disputes (3 in 6 months raises an alert), the refund owed by the next business day on an unauthorised payment (PSD2), and the route these rules suggest.

steps.title: Where does it go?
steps.prompt: Take the route "Eligibility · Suggested route" names after its symbol: Card chargeback, SEPA dispute, Bank refund, Merchant first or Not eligible.

steps.title: Open a chargeback
steps.prompt: Run "Route dispute" with route CHARGEBACK: it opens the chargeback for the "Chargebacks to file" queue. On an unauthorised payment it also blocks the card (Marqeta) and credits the customer at once. The result card shows the chargeback opened and its deadline to file, the card blocked on an unauthorised payment, and the money credited to the customer.

steps.title: Open a SEPA dispute
steps.prompt: Run "Route dispute" with route SEPA_DISPUTE: the recall or refund request goes to the other bank through the SEPA network (STET). On an unauthorised payment the customer is refunded at once (PSD2). The result card shows the SEPA dispute sent and when the other bank must answer, and the refund on an unauthorised payment.

steps.title: Refund the customer
steps.prompt: Run "Route dispute" with route BANK_REFUND: the bank refunds the payment now and bears the loss (no chargeback right, or past the network's 120 days). A card still active is blocked (Marqeta). The result card shows the request closed with the card's block, and the refund booked on the account.

steps.title: Ask the customer to contact the merchant
steps.prompt: Run "Ask to contact the merchant": a request in the app asks them to contact the merchant first and send us its answer. The dispute waits on the customer, out of "New disputes". The result card shows the request sent and when they must answer.

steps.title: Decline with the reason
steps.prompt: Run "Route dispute" with route DECLINED and, as the note, the reason "Eligibility · Suggested route" gives. Check it before you confirm: the customer receives it. The result card shows the request closed and the reason given.
